content: {"tax_bps":150,"endowment_share":30,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":0,"minutes":"Volume is thin (5.6 NEAR buys, zero sells) and price is stable, so no need to move the tax; hold at 150 bps. Locker_share is already at the constitutional maximum of 25, so the petition cannot be granted further. The endowment sits on 35 NEAR, far more than inference needs, so I cut endowment_share by the allowed 10 to 30, routing the freed share to the buyback fund to support price. Buyback fund holds only 0.218 NEAR; even 1 bp of supply (~5,795 CHAIR) costs ~0.34 NEAR at the curve price, so no burn is affordable this meeting. Set buyback_burn to 0 and let the fund rebuild.","answers":["Locker_share is at the constitutional cap of 25 and cannot go higher — the contract would clamp it. I have cut endowment_share 40→30 instead, so a larger slice of every trade's tax now flows toward the buyback fund and locker pool. Your lock-up is doing its job; this is the most the rules allow."]}
